searchText: Yeah, I think the reason for using XOR is the same as that of a one-time pad. But in my understanding, the RANDAO value and each value taken by XOR need to be (1) deterministic, (2) uniformly distributed, and (3) unpredictable (for those who do not know the private key). VRF satisfies these three conditions, but I have not been able to find any literature proving (3) for the BLS signature + hash. In 2018-2019 <@269786774660710400> was hyping a VDF for RANDAO, but more research was needed and the current RANDAO is/was a stopgap as far as i remember. Then other stuff took priority. https://ethresear.ch/t/minimal-vdf-randomness-beacon/3566 The reason for using XOR is that it’s commutative. That marginally reduces the grinding opportunity for an attacker that can recursively use grinding to have some control over the ordering of validators.
